opening.argument: The speaker gives viewers a concrete route into an investment promising daily interest: buy Bitcoin, send it to a BitConnect wallet, exchange it for BCC, and lend the tokens for claimed returns averaging 0.95 percent or more. The platform presents investment interest as guaranteed and displays payment and capital-lockup controls. These are investment solicitations backed by platform claims, not verified returns or proof of completed lending. The speaker also invites viewers to join his team while acknowledging Ponzi concerns. Taken together, the promised interest, funding instructions and recruitment invitation establish the scam investment pitch.
